WITH fmi AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan, AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_fmi
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
ev AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan, e.events_reg,
         (m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric AS total_spend,
         (e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric + 1.5*(e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric + 2*(e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric AS eps
  FROM membershipandspending m JOIN eventsandclub e ON e.events_member_pivot = m.member_reg)
SELECT f.nick_label, ROUND(ev.total_spend,2) AS total_spend_usd, ev.eps AS event_participation_score,
       l.loyalty_snapshot->>'reward_tier' AS loyalty_reward_tier
FROM ev
JOIN fmi ON fmi.fan = ev.fan
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = ev.fan
LEFT JOIN loyaltyandachievements l ON l.loyalty_events_pivot = ev.events_reg
WHERE fmi.avg_fmi > 20 AND ev.eps > 25
ORDER BY ev.total_spend DESC

WITH d AS (
  SELECT (s.feedback_data->>'NPS_Val')::numeric AS nps,
         c.merch_spend_usd::numeric / NULLIF((m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric,0) AS mas
  FROM supportandfeedback s
  JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.pref_reg = s.support_pref_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = p.preferences_member_pivot
  JOIN commerceandcollection c ON c.commerce_member_pivot = m.member_reg)
SELECT CASE WHEN nps BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Platform Promoters' ELSE 'Detractors' END AS fan_segment,
       ROUND(AVG(mas),2) AS avg_mas
FROM d WHERE nps BETWEEN 9 AND 10 OR nps BETWEEN 0 AND 6
GROUP BY 1

WITH fm AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan,
         AVG(watch_hrs::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_cci,
         AVG((chat_activity->>'Chat_Msg')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_cs
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
el AS (SELECT fan FROM fm WHERE avg_cci > 0.5 AND avg_cs < 0.5)
SELECT e.cont_pref AS content_preference, COUNT(DISTINCT el.fan) AS engaged_lurker_count
FROM el
JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = el.fan
JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_activity_pivot = i.activity_reg
GROUP BY e.cont_pref
ORDER BY engaged_lurker_count DESC

WITH im AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan,
         AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_fmi,
         AVG(watch_hrs::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_cci
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
ps AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan,
         AVG(((p.usage_metrics->>'Int_Consist')::numeric + (p.usage_metrics->>'Plat_Stable')::numeric)/2) AS pss
  FROM preferencesandsettings p JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = p.preferences_member_pivot
  GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot),
base AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry AS fan, f.nick_label, ps.pss, im.avg_fmi, im.avg_cci,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.pss) AS pss_pct,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY im.avg_fmi) AS fmi_pct,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY im.avg_cci) AS cci_pct
  FROM fans f JOIN ps ON ps.fan = f.user_registry JOIN im ON im.fan = f.user_registry),
hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan
  FROM retentionandinfluence r JOIN engagement g ON g.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = g.engage_member_pivot
  WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High')
SELECT b.nick_label, ROUND(b.pss_pct::numeric,3) AS pss_percentile, ROUND(b.fmi_pct::numeric,3) AS fmi_percentile, ROUND(b.cci_pct::numeric,3) AS cci_percentile
FROM base b JOIN hr ON hr.fan = b.fan
ORDER BY b.pss_pct ASC

WITH fmi AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan, AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_fmi
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
eps AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan,
         MAX((e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric + 1.5*(e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric + 2*(e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric) AS eps
  FROM eventsandclub e JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = e.events_member_pivot
  GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot),
superfans AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry AS fan, f.reg_moment::date AS reg_date
  FROM fans f JOIN fmi ON fmi.fan = f.user_registry JOIN eps ON eps.fan = f.user_registry
  WHERE fmi.avg_fmi > 20 AND eps.eps > 25),
daily AS (
  SELECT s.fan, (i.time_mark::date - s.reg_date) AS days_since_reg,
         SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) AS day_spend
  FROM superfans s JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = s.fan
  GROUP BY s.fan, i.time_mark::date, s.reg_date),
cum AS (
  SELECT fan, days_since_reg,
         SUM(day_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY fan ORDER BY days_since_reg) AS cumulative_spend
  FROM daily),
milestones AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (7),(30),(90)) v(milestone_days))
SELECT ms.milestone_days, ROUND(AVG(c.cumulative_spend),2) AS avg_cumulative_spend
FROM milestones ms JOIN cum c ON c.days_since_reg BETWEEN 0 AND ms.milestone_days
GROUP BY ms.milestone_days
ORDER BY ms.milestone_days

WITH pmi AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan, MAX((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS peak_fmi
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
ranked AS (
  SELECT f.nick_label, f.user_registry, p.peak_fmi, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.peak_fmi DESC) AS fan_rank
  FROM pmi p JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = p.fan
  WHERE p.peak_fmi > 20)
SELECT nick_label, user_registry, ROUND(peak_fmi,2) AS peak_monetization_index, fan_rank
FROM ranked WHERE fan_rank <= 10 ORDER BY fan_rank

WITH m AS (
  SELECT f.nick_label,
         SQRT((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric) AS cii,
         (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric / NULLIF((s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric,0) AS ffr
  FROM socialcommunity s
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN engagement g ON g.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending ms ON ms.member_reg = g.engage_member_pivot
  JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = ms.member_fan_pivot
  WHERE (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric > 0),
ranked AS (
  SELECT nick_label, cii, ffr, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cii DESC) AS influence_rank
  FROM m WHERE ffr > 2.0 AND cii > 10000)
SELECT nick_label, ROUND(cii,2) AS community_influence_index, ROUND(ffr,2) AS follower_following_ratio, influence_rank
FROM ranked WHERE influence_rank <= 20 ORDER BY influence_rank

WITH sls AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan,
         MAX(COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::numeric,0)) AS sls
  FROM supportandfeedback s
  JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.pref_reg = s.support_pref_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = p.preferences_member_pivot
  GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot),
churn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement g ON g.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = g.engage_member_pivot
  WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High'),
cls AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry AS fan,
         CASE WHEN c.fan IS NOT NULL THEN 'At-Risk' ELSE 'Not At-Risk' END AS churn_status,
         CASE WHEN s.sls > 10 THEN 'High-Maintenance' ELSE 'Low-Maintenance' END AS support_status
  FROM fans f LEFT JOIN sls s ON s.fan = f.user_registry LEFT JOIN churn c ON c.fan = f.user_registry)
SELECT churn_status, support_status, COUNT(DISTINCT fan) AS fan_count
FROM cls GROUP BY churn_status, support_status

WITH cf AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan
  FROM commerceandcollection c JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = c.commerce_member_pivot
  WHERE COALESCE(c.dig_own,0) + COALESCE(c.phys_own,0) > 50 AND c.coll_comp_rate > 75)
SELECT v.genre_tag AS idol_genre, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.fan) AS collector_fan_count
FROM cf
JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = cf.fan
JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entity_reg = i.interact_idol_pivot
GROUP BY v.genre_tag
ORDER BY collector_fan_count DESC

WITH infl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ms.member_fan_pivot AS fan
  FROM socialcommunity s
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN engagement g ON g.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending ms ON ms.member_reg = g.engage_member_pivot
  WHERE (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric > 0
    AND (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric / (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric > 2.0
    AND SQRT((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric) > 10000),
key_int AS (
  SELECT i.activity_reg, i.interact_idol_pivot, i.time_mark
  FROM interactions i JOIN infl ON infl.fan = i.interact_fan_pivot),
sess AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.activity_reg, o.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' AS tone
  FROM key_int k
  JOIN interactions o ON o.interact_idol_pivot = k.interact_idol_pivot
   AND o.time_mark BETWEEN k.time_mark - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND k.time_mark + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  WHERE o.interact_fan_pivot NOT IN (SELECT fan FROM infl))
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone = 'Positive') AS positive_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone = 'Negative') AS negative_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone = 'Neutral') AS neutral_count
FROM sess
note: Returns zeros: no two interactions with the same idol fall within 5 minutes of each other in this data. Counts interactions (by Msg_Tone) rather than summing Chat_Msg.
